description: How Taseli would approach one question on this business's account, as a decision: the verdict for the account's stage (computed from its own numbers) and tracking, the principle Taseli follows on the topic, the owner's own rules (they outrank Taseli's practice), Taseli's recommended monthly budget where money is the question, and what not to do now and why. Topics: budget, bidding, structure, pausing, creatives, audiences, tracking, launch, scaling, seasons. It is guidance, not a requirement. Read only.

account.description: An ad account's name, when it is about one account only; omit when it is about the whole business.

question.description: The question in a short English line, e.g. 'Should we raise the budget on the plumbing campaign?'

topic.description: The topic, when you know it; else it is read from the question.

name: get_guidance

approvalUrl.description: Where the owner approves it, in Taseli.

tool.description: A ready call with its arguments.

who.description: taseli: Taseli does it or already watches; owner: a tap in Taseli or a fix on the site; agent: the caller may do it.

answer.description: The answer in one line, in the asked language. Every number in it comes from Taseli's code.

asOf.description: The day the data runs to (the daily sync).

why.description: Why, in numbers (days, results, what was left out).

dontDo.description: What not to do now, and why.

error.description: Why nothing was judged, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of a decision (nothing connected yet, not available here).

reasons.description: At most 3 (6 with detail full), strongest first.

n.description: Peers only: how many businesses the figure comes from.

title: How Taseli would do it
